*New Program Highlights*
New - Ph.D. in Bioengineering
A graduate degree from North Carolina A&T will give you the tools you need to accomplish more and go further in your chosen field. Combining rigorous academics with real-world educational applications and cutting-edge research opportunities, our graduate programs offer the next important step in your academic and professional development.
The University offers 15 Doctoral Degree programs, 34 Master’s Degree programs, and 20 Graduate Certificate programs. View our full list of offerings below.
APPLY NOW!
